authority: CONTROLLED BASELINE PROFILE A/B AUTHORITY — NOT A UNIVERSAL ANDROID PERFORMANCE CLAIM

dataset.source: public Music storage and MediaStore; Room was not seeded

journeys.G3: real Albums browse, scroll, and artwork loading
journeys.G4: real playback of Track 00010 through LibrePlayer playback authority
journeys.G5: real Now Playing surface showing Track 00010

generation_reproducibility.policy: Two independent profile-free target builds; exact text first, canonical sorted rules second, normalized rule identity diagnostic only. Any membership difference is NOT REPRODUCIBLE.

baseline_profile.finding: Strict identity differs by two asynchronous LibraryRefreshStore coroutine edges. Class count, package distribution, G1-G5 completion, and exclusion checks are identical; remaining text differences are H/P/S flag shifts.

startup_profile.finding: Strict identity differs at bounded asynchronous library-refresh and artwork-loading edges; class count, package distribution, G1-G5 completion, and exclusion checks are identical.

invalid_attempt.reason: Nominal run 2 packaged run 1 as a predecessor and therefore was not profile-free; it is preserved but excluded.

candidate.reason: Valid profile-free run, complete G1-G5 coverage, and a strict superset of run 2's normalized baseline identities; no evidence favored discarding its two additional asynchronous repository edges.

profile_disabled_release.note: Dependency profiles remain; the app candidate source was absent.

ab_method.comparison: same current source and identical app/test APK hashes; only Macrobenchmark compilation state differs
ab_method.disabled: CompilationMode.None(); resets compilation and performs no pre-compilation
ab_method.enabled: CompilationMode.Partial(BaselineProfileMode.Require, warmupIterations = 0); missing profile installation is a test failure

ttid_ms.classification: NO CREDIBLE BENEFIT; delta is inside disabled between-session spread

frame_overrun.songs: All P50/P90/P95/P99 session pairs improve; P99 remains noisy.
frame_overrun.albums: P50/P90/P95 improve in 3/3 sessions; P99 improves in 2/3 and is not treated as independent high-tail authority.

art_proof.disabled: After reset, dexopt status=verify reason=cmdline; ProfileInstaller skips installation.
art_proof.enabled: ProfileInstaller RESULT_INSTALL_SUCCESS; artd chooses speed-profile and dex2oat receives a profile file; final dexopt status=speed-profile reason=cmdline.

invalid_apparatus_history: Baseline Profile plugin 1.4.1 was incompatible with AGP 9.1; official plugin 1.5.0-rc02 is used.
An initial architecture placed production generation in :benchmark; corrected to the dedicated official :baselineprofile producer before accepted evidence.
The sandbox default debug-keystore path was unwritable; test-host user state was redirected without changing production configuration.
A UTP C:\tmp host-path failure was an environment failure and is excluded.
An AVD process exit interrupted apparatus work; completed evidence was recovered or the incomplete side alone was resumed.
A fixed-scroll journey failed to reach Track 00010; deterministic Search selection replaced it.
strictStability exposed a viewport mismatch in the composite journey; startup retains strict stability and critical journeys use bounded repeated collection.
Stateful producer replay made a combined journey invalid; journeys were made independently repeatable.
The Search result text node was not clickable; the accepted journey selects its clickable ancestor.
Search/miniplayer route state initially prevented real Now Playing entry; bounded Back coordinate delivery established the real route transition.
Pause accessibility text was unreliable and is not playback authority.
A stale Media3 mini-player UI node was handled with bounded reacquisition.
Keyboard/Back behavior varied during route exit; accepted evidence requires the EditText to disappear and Songs to return.
A failed gesture injection is rejected rather than counted; accepted journeys require successful normalized swipes.
A route-exit coordinate delivery miss was corrected with a bounded three-attempt retry and explicit route-state assertion.
CompilationMode.Partial(BaselineProfileMode.Disable, warmupIterations=0) is rejected by AndroidX Benchmark 1.4.1; the documented control is CompilationMode.None().
An initial MediaSession assertion expected numeric state=3, while API 36 renders PLAYING(3); corrected before accepted measurements.
Earlier cutoff-coordinate and run-1 route-exit delivery experiments are preserved outside accepted roots and excluded.
The packaged-predecessor generation attempt is preserved and excluded from reproducibility authority.
limitations: Strict two-run text and canonical profile reproducibility was not achieved; bounded asynchronous rule membership is reported, not hidden.
TTID did not establish a credible benefit; TTFD and scrolling frame-duration results did.
Evidence is from one controlled API 36 x86_64 emulator, not physical-device, acoustic, thermal, battery, or universal Android authority.
R8/minification, LARGE, and new memory/resource authority are outside Q1.1h; Q1.1g remains authoritative for memory/resources.
D8 may discard generated synthetic signatures that do not map after bytecode rewriting; the packaged ART profile and speed-profile application are the delivery authority.

regenerate_when: Songs or Albums rendering changes materially
AGP, AndroidX Benchmark, or Baseline Profile plugin changes
maintenance.review_rule: Repeat two profile-free generations, preserve strict classification, inspect the packaged profile, then rerun the balanced A/B matrix before replacing the candidate.
